body:
## What to build

Respect warnings promoted to errors while preflighting names-only Grouping selections, before any backend metadata work. A caller using `options(warn = 2)` must receive the selector's original converted-warning error without an avoidable metadata query or a replacement metadata refusal.

On main `4b34fdecb2d8a41034b3d9b5d5af8e51592555e1`, inspecting a live DuckDB input with a Grouping specification selecting `one_of("absent")` under warn = 2 sends a zero-row metadata query before reporting the converted warning. Direct tidyselect and local inspection already establish that error from the available names. The same selection in fixed `.by` sends no query. On a derived dtplyr input with unsafe typed metadata, adding a later numeric type-predicate selection instead replaces the original error with a metadata-safety refusal recommending collection. Collecting cannot repair the absent column.

The 260-call matrix found 60 actual extra DuckDB query invocations and 90 dtplyr metadata refusals replacing converted selector errors, with local and names-only controls separating the boundary. A deprecated data-pronoun selection with its lifecycle warning enabled reproduced the warning-promotion boundary as well. Temporary tracing observed DBI invocation rather than inferring receipt from Sent query records. Closed #1090 and repair #1120 covered leading errors that the quiet discarded preflight still sees; they did not cover errors lost by suppressing their originating warning. ADR 0005 owns the locally decidable-error ordering contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With warnings promoted to errors, an independently names-only Grouping selection error precedes metadata acquisition for inspection and supported Margin verbs.
- [ ] A later typed selection does not replace that error or trigger backend work before it; derived dtplyr preserves the selector condition rather than a metadata-safety refusal.
- [ ] Live SQL controls count actual metadata entry-point invocations and observe zero for the invalid names-only selection.
- [ ] Default warning behavior, lifecycle warning/error settings, valid selections, fixed-key preflight, and the existing mixed-leading-error cases preserve their intended conditions and evaluation counts.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body: The minimized replay, contract, expected/observed result, controls and duplicate comparison are retained in the [dated investigation evidence](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/9627abf5564d2f084f8c39700528fb51ee73a601/investigation/2026-11-03-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/grouping/findings.md). The report mode passed and the desired-contract assertion mode failed on the investigated main snapshot. Investigation-only PR #1189 publishes the evidence; this issue remains open for the separate repair.
Implemented in #1198. Verification and review records are linked from the pull request.

title: [P2] Preserve warning-promoted Grouping errors before metadata acquisition
